alignments.note: The ASV compresses the address Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί into the single word *Brethren*, which answers wholly to ἀδελφοί; no part of it answers to ἄνδρες, so rule 39's test leaves the vocative ἄνδρες empty under rule 23. Joining the two tokens on *Brethren* remains defensible.
Imperative with its supplied English subject *ye* as a rule 7 helper; rule 9 heads on the lexical verb *hear*.
The genitive object μου is realized as the subject *I* of the relative clause the ASV builds around the noun phrase.

Rule 31: an article preceding its expressed head noun with a verbless (prepositional) modifier between takes the English determiner together with the supplied relativizer, discontinuously under rule 15, headed on *the*.
Rule 62: the supplied lexical verb *make* rides with the preposition whose phrase is the predicate; rule 62 heads such a unit on the word realizing the preposition, *unto*.
ἀπολογίας → *defence*, bare, its determiner having gone to the article standing in front of it.

review_notes: Ἄνδρες left unrepresented under rule 39's test; the competing join on *Brethren* is named in its note.
The supplied relative frame is divided under rules 31 and 62: *the … which* to the article, *make unto* to πρός.
